descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-19 Medication Tracker · S16 「谁下的医嘱 × 有没有说 'task' → 是不是任务（两种模式）」 Who gave the order × said 'task' → task or not (both contexts)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T1 Orders for others ('PT to walk him') are not tasks unless the physician says 'task', in both contexts.（TFA-92597 R10；TFA-92597 AC 1）
  • U6 'Let's start X' is a plan: it becomes a task, not a row.（UAT TC-19 ER 3；TFA-92597 R3）
  • U18 The step mix (starts, holds, stops, dose changes, conditional orders, one-time doses) is dictated across two days and passes in both Hospital and Nursing Home.（UAT TC-19 Steps；UAT 3.3）

测试设计方法：决策表（decision-table） — 几个条件的组合列成表，每个组合各验一次，看结果是不是按规则变。

Given Fresh physician with the fixture Hospital patient and Nursing Home resident; live models

When Hospital: type the Hospital text in the encounter notes and Save & Extract, open Post-Round → tasks. Nursing Home: type the Nursing Home text and Save & Extract, open the tasks list

Then Cells: physician's own plan, no codeword ('Let's start metolazone', 'Let's start vitamin B12') → task; another discipline, no codeword ('PT to walk him', 'Nursing to check fingersticks', 'PT to work on transfers', 'Nursing to weigh her daily') → no task; …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs per checkpoint: tasks mustContain the 'task' cells, mustNotContain the no-task cells. The dietitian result is in spec.manual: main leaves nutrition out of the delegation filter on purpose (convex/lib/delegatedTasks.ts), and whether that is right is Q20. …

在哪跑：dev 单元 U29；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S16 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-19.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：AICHECK · AI 输出检查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
